description: This file declares the class OpenCDMSessionPrivate, which manages CDM sessions, including license handling, key management, and session lifecycle for a media decryption module. It includes method declarations for license requests, session updates, key status checks, and protection metadata handling, along with private members for session state and dependencies.

classes.name: OpenCDMSessionPrivate
classes.description: A class implementing a private CDM session, handling license requests, key management, and session lifecycle for media decryption.
